description: This file contains a Python module implementing a ConfigFuzzer class for fuzz testing configuration spaces in PyTorch's _inductor module. It includes functions for type checking, sampling, and running tests with different configurations, as well as visualization of results.

classes.name: DummyPass
classes.description: A dummy implementation of CustomGraphPass used for testing.

classes.name: DummyPartitionerFn
classes.description: A dummy implementation of CustomPartitionerFn used for testing.

classes.name: TypeExemplars
classes.description: Provides example instances of specific types for sampling.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Enumeration of possible test result statuses in the ConfigFuzzer.

classes.name: SamplingMethod
classes.description: Enum for sampling strategies (TOGGLE, RANDOM) for generating config values.

classes.name: ResultType
classes.description: Tracks the mapping of configuration combinations to their test outcomes.

classes.name: ConfigFuzzer
classes.description: Main class for fuzz testing configuration spaces in PyTorch's _inductor module.

methods.name: is_type
methods.description: Checks if a type hint matches a specific type.

methods.name: is_optional_type
methods.description: Checks if a type hint is an Optional type.

methods.name: is_callable_type
methods.description: Checks if a type hint is a Callable.

methods.name: example
methods.description: Returns an example instance of a given type.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a type is in the TYPE_EXEMPLARS dictionary.

methods.name: check_halide_import
methods.description: Checks if the 'halide' module is available.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Runs a test with a given configuration, handling eager and compiled execution, and records results.

methods.name: fuzz_n_tuple
methods.description: Tests all combinations of n configs up to a maximum number of combinations.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves current fuzzer state to a file.

methods.name: load_state
methods.description: Loads fuzzer state from a file.

methods.name: bisect
methods.description: Performs a bisection search to find minimal failing configuration.

methods.name: _bisect_failing_config
methods.description: Helper for bisect to find minimal failing config.

methods.name: _bisect_failing_config_helper
methods.description: Recursive helper for bisect to narrow down failing configs.

methods.name: visualize_results
methods.description: Generates an HTML visualization of test results for 2D config combinations.
